title: Logic, Inductive and Deductive
author: William Minto

authorInfo.bio: William Minto (1845–1893) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Logic, Inductive and Deductive" by William Minto is a scholarly treatise on the principles of logic written in the late 19th century. The work delves into the historical evolution and practical application of logical reasoning, emphasizing both inductive and deductive methods.
